title: Platform manifest
description: Layer 1 — platform repo declaration of foundation pin and optional filters/overrides.

foundationVersion.description: Pin to a foundation release (semver or tag).

modeSetRestrictions.description: Restricts the valid mode values for each named mode set on this platform. Keys are mode set names; values declare which modes are allowed.

allowed.description: Allowed mode values for this mode set. Must be a subset of the mode set's declared modes and must include the mode set's default.

extensions.description: Platform-local tokens, mode sets, and formatting rules.

tokens.description: Platform-local token definitions, in cascade-format (same shape as a cascade token file).

components.description: Platform-local component specs, injected into the component catalog (add-or-replace by name).

fields.description: Platform-local field declarations, injected into the field catalog (add-or-replace by name).

platformExtensions.description: Platform-local terminology extensions (e.g. iOS state vocabulary), annotating ids in an existing base registry.

guidelines.description: Platform-local guideline docs, injected into the guideline catalog (add-or-replace by name).

formatting.description: Rules for serializing structured name objects into platform-specific token name strings.

conceptOrder.description: Ordered list of field names for serialization. Values must match declared field names from the design system's field catalog (field.schema.json declarations). Replaces the default serialization.position order from each field declaration.

casing.description: Casing style for serialized token names. Default: kebab-case.

delimiter.description: Character(s) separating concepts in the serialized string. Default: -.

abbreviations.description: Map of full term to abbreviated form, applied after ordering and before casing.
